title: PHASE 4 — executed value provenance (BCM4352 rev42 operational path)

writers: wlc_phy_attach @0xbeff8: mov %al,0x16e(%rbx), al=(edx>>0x14)&0xff (AC path, phytype==0xb); edx=(r13d<<16)|r14d; r13d,r14d = 16-bit reads of *(pi+0x148)+0x3da (= si_radio reg 0x3da) after writes to +0x3d8
values.initialization_order: pi is memset-zero, then wlc_phy_attach decodes the radio chip revision from radio register 0x3da and stores the major revision byte to pi+0x16e; this runs before wlc_phy_init's first radio-ON
values.board_phyrev_chanspec_dependency: HARDWARE (radio register 0x3da read); phytype 0xb selects the AC decode path
values.value_at_first_bringup_callsite: UNKNOWN (hardware-derived; radio reg 0x3da bits 4..11). NOT statically determinable.
consumers: wlc_phy_switch_radio_acphy @0xaa7c0 branch: ==1 -> PLL seq A, ==2 -> PLL seq B, else skip

values.identity: AC PHY rxcore state (byte); set from the wlc_phy_rxcore_setstate_acphy state argument
values.initialization_order: written by the callee immediately before the read (same function)
values.value_at_first_bringup_callsite: UNKNOWN (runtime rxcore state argument at the first cal)

values.identity: AC PHY table-write value byte (paired with 0x8bf)
values.initialization_order: written inside sub_a7089 (wlc_phy_stf_chain_temp_throttle_acphy) from a runtime loop value

values.identity: AC PHY table-write value byte (paired with 0x8be)
values.initialization_order: no store found; read as a byte

values.identity: static coefficient tables in .data (4428 bytes each): rx_farrow_tbl, rx_farrow_tbl_rev3, rx_farrow_tbl_40_rev3, tx_farrow_dac1_tbl, tx_farrow_dac1_tbl_rev3, tx_farrow_dac1_tbl_40_rev3, tx_farrow_dac2_tbl, tx_farrow_dac3_tbl
values.board_phyrev_chanspec_dependency: table SELECTION is runtime (chip id `acphychipid` (.bss) + phyrev/rev3 + rodata tables); coefficient VALUES are static
values.value_at_first_bringup_callsite: static table contents; selected index/data runtime

summary.note: The earlier apparent set of pi+0x16e writers {0,1,2} were `cmpb` READS misclassified as stores; the real store is wlc_phy_attach's radio-revision decode (hardware) plus one LPPHY 16-bit store.
